key_insight: Localizing and selectively updating function-specific LLM subnetworks can reduce catastrophic forgetting while supporting efficient continual learning.
engineering_relevance: CiMEO restricts parameter updates and optimizer states to selected subnetworks, offering a path to more resource-efficient model adaptation.
method: Identify functional subnetworks using gradient-attribution profiling.
Route each training example to its corresponding subnetwork.
Restrict updates and optimizer states to the selected regions.
evidence_signal: Across 1.4 million sequential instructions, CiMEO achieved the highest average performance among compared methods on five generative benchmarks covering programming, examination-style tasks, and mathematical reasoning.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify routing overhead or memory savings, leaving practical efficiency gains to be verified.
paper_title: Functional Subnetwork Localization for Efficient Continual Learning in Large Language Models
